description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - Convene the meeting for the election to fill the Vacant of Chairman of Manthai west Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the convening of a meeting for the election to fill the vacant position of Chairman of Manthai West Pradeshiya Sabha. It specifically relates to electoral processes at the local government level under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
